projects.title: Hungarian Flair
projects.description:
We were selected by the Hungarian Embassy in Kosova to organize and promote the Hungarian Cultural Weeks - a number of cultural events spanning from September to December 2018.

The events consisted of a philharmonic concert, jazz gigs, movie nights, a photography exhibition and a book launch, each of them packed with enthusiasts enjoying a pieces of rich Hungarian culture coming to Kosova.

In addition to the organizing of the events, we designed and produced a number of promotional materials, including leaflets, social media posts and videos promoting the Hungarian culture.
